research_question: What is the strongest non-interventional current delta toward a scientifically admissible Qwen3-0.6B J-Space control claim after simplex, v6 second-order controls, v7 evidence binding, modularity binding and exact preregistration/runtime binding converged in parallel?

observed_current_state.current_promotion_line: evidence-bound v7 composed with current modularity companion plus exact preregistration/runtime binding

material_findings.statement: The v6 gate could be presented a structurally complete candidate whose second-order receipt fields were merely syntactically valid 64-hex strings plus self-declared booleans. That is sufficient for boundary-unit fixtures but not for causal evidence authentication.

durable_counterexample.form: expectedFailure preserving the desired fail-closed invariant

material_findings.successor_resolution: Parallel current work introduced v7 evidence binding and later kept semantic-factorial evidence authority single under v7; therefore the v6 counterexample is retained as a historical falsifier, not as a competing gate.

material_findings.statement: The current native semantic counterbalanced executor requests only AFFIRMATIVE while rotating A/B/C output codes in calibration and holdout. It therefore cannot by itself produce the exact semantic-target x output-code 3x3 universe required by the evidence-bound successor path.
material_findings.consequence: Legacy 1x3 output-code counterbalancing must not be silently upgraded into a 3x3 semantic-target factorial.

material_findings.statement: A future executor needs a deterministic producer that freezes all nine target x code cases for calibration and all nine for independent holdout, expands every case over the exact six factorial evidence controls, and binds only actually observed runtime receipt digests. Missing controls must fail closed and no runtime digest may be synthesized.

The current preregistration/runtime binding successor additionally requires exact frozen plan identity, scenario families, lexical families, seeds, metric definition, residual-norm measurement and native token-scope binding. A 3x3 producer is therefore necessary but insufficient unless its eventual executed case universe is bound to the exact frozen preregistration receipt.
material_findings.consequence: Do not wire the producer directly to promotion as a second authority. The executor should consume a valid frozen preregistration plan and emit one case universe that simultaneously satisfies preregistration binding, semantic-factorial evidence binding and modularity evidence binding.

rank_provenance_admission.role: Delegates to the single numerical rank analyzer while fail-closing missing exact source identity, holdout-closed and label/output-code-free declarations and prompt-hash uniqueness.

research_hypothesis.statement: A genuine Qwen3-0.6B J-Space semantic control mechanism should survive model-facing label removal, scenario blocking, lexical-family changes, exact target x output-code counterbalancing, family-balanced rank metrology, residual-norm operating-point control, context-valid dual readout, downstream nonterminal transport, native Q8_0 geometry reconstruction and modular cross-effect tests while remaining bound to one preregistered exact-source case universe.
